title: Implement canonical mathematical IR JSON round trips
commitMessage: feat: qualify canonical versioned exact mathematical IR JSON codec

contribution.summary: Observe independent missing-codec REDs, install deterministic math-ir/1 JSON serialization and decoding of exact rationals, binary64 bits, units, symbols, matrices, operations and restrictions, and verify ten round-trip oracles and full regressions.
contribution.value: Preserves exact quantities and scope/domain semantics across a reusable .NET JSON transport without implicit numeric widening or provider-specific AST dependencies.
debtChanges: T2 remains open for adversarial JSON decoding, duplicate and unknown keys, scope integrity and distinct semantic/presentation hashes.
Canonical structural byte identity is not an algebraic equivalence proof; OpenMath/MathML adapters remain future work.
No external AURA adoption or publication is claimed.
contribution.nextAction: Qualify M2-W01-C03-T2 with independent adversarial JSON decoder and hash tests before completing the codec chunk.

achievements.achievement: Independent REDs show missing public canonical IR JSON codec and missing Encode/Decode contract.
Versioned math-ir/1 codec carries exact BigInteger fractions, binary64 bits, quantities, symbol binding, matrices and domain restrictions in deterministic JSON.
Ten round-trip oracles plus existing IR, quantities, foundation and locked-build regressions qualify structural determinism and exact typed values.
The functional canonical codec contract closes with observed RED and executable GREEN; adversarial decoding and semantic/presentation hashing remain in T2.
